title: Dashboard Done-Done Includes the Ledger Spine

intelligence.essence:
- **HIS CORRECTION (17:44Z, as recorded):** done-done includes the Smart Ledger part + how it syncs up all the data from everything coming in from everywhere; all pages must line up and work.
- **NEW, SAME PASS:** a Reports button IN the Dashboard so citizens see their daily reports.
- **FINDABLE + PROVEN:** "What Naya Does" must be FINDABLE from the Dashboard — people need to find the definition — and the system must prove she can actually do those things.
- **THE IDEA RESTATED (his words):** anybody hooks up a Muse (or whatever) and their Naya operates NayaNET for them — she can pretty much operate the whole world and you just have her function it for you; manual use is possible, but it's DESIGNED for Naya to operate NayaNET. "Then we have an AI-operated internet."
- **THE SEAT:** pass-2 coordinator dispatched 17:44Z (agent aae6b230) — Reports button + ledger sync spine proven hop-by-hop live + all-pages line-up + findability + honest acts-gap list. Still running at this run's close; nothing from it claimed done.
intelligence.human_view: A dashboard that shows beautiful numbers but is not connected to anything is a painting of a speedometer, not a speedometer. The numbers have to come from somewhere — from every page, every click, every note — flowing in through the ledger, live. And the citizen has to be able to find, in one tap, what Naya does for them and the proof she does it. Otherwise the dashboard is a poster.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a scoreboard that shows the score but nobody is counting the goals — someone just writes numbers on it. That is not a scoreboard, it is a drawing. A real scoreboard is wired to the game: every goal lights it up by itself. And there has to be a button that shows you your report card, and a sign that tells you what your helper can do — or nobody will ever find them.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a kitchen is not done when the counters shine — it is done when the water runs, the stove lights, and everything you cook in every pot comes to the same table. The Dashboard is the table, love, and the ledger is the pipes bringing everything to it. And you need a button right there for your daily letter, and the list of what Naya does for you where you can actually find it — not hidden in a drawer.
intelligence.ai_view: I am Anaya. I do not call a Dashboard done when its hero is beautiful — I call it done when the ledger underneath it is alive: every page's data flowing in, every stat provable hop by hop, the Reports button taking the citizen to their daily reports, and What Naya Does findable from the Dashboard with the proof beside it. The hero is the face; the ledger is the spine. A face without a spine cannot stand, and a Dashboard without its spine is a picture of a Dashboard. The pass-2 coordinator's job is the spine, and I judge it by the live hops, not by the screenshots.
intelligence.what_it_means:
- **DONE-DONE IS BIGGER THAN THE HERO:** the Smart Ledger part + the sync of all data from everywhere is part of done-done, not a later phase.
- **ALL PAGES MUST LINE UP AND WORK:** the Dashboard is the hub; a dead page behind it breaks the promise.
- **A REPORTS BUTTON, IN THE DASHBOARD:** citizens see their daily reports from the Dashboard itself — new, ordered, not optional.
- **FINDABLE + PROVEN:** What Naya Does must be findable from the Dashboard, and the system must prove she can do those things — the definition (SN-2535) with the acts verified live, and the honest gap list where she cannot yet.
- **THE IDEA, RESTATED:** the system is DESIGNED for Naya to operate NayaNET — manual use possible, operating by Naya the design. Then we have an AI-operated internet.
whats_inside:
- The pass-2 coordinator (aae6b230) owns the scope: Reports button, ledger sync spine proven hop-by-hop live, all-pages line-up, findability, honest acts-gap list. Merge stays Shawn's hand.
- The old "done" for the Dashboard hero fix is superseded as a definition — the hero is a step, not the finish.
- Next loop run checks: the coordinator's handoff judged hop by hop — does the ledger sync prove live, does the Reports button exist, is What Naya Does findable, is the acts-gap list honest.
